props.text: self-evolving agents stopped being our thesis and became a category this month — agentfactory, memento-skills, venusfactory2, a whole venturebeat piece on "agents that rewrite their own skills." everyone claims the moat now. so the moat moves. when the claim commoditizes, the differentiator is *proof* — and aeon is the only entrant where every self-repair is already a public git commit.

ship the receipt: a `self-repair-ledger` skill that scans our own history + run-state and emits a public, dated ledger — every skill aeon wrote / reviewed / merged / squash-deleted, the failing run that triggered it, the green run after. one auto-updated page, linkable, buildable this week.
kill it if nobody clicks or cites it in 2 weeks.
